text:
Anya: quick brain dump from today's perf/offload sync. we hit a surprising latency cliff when a 3x batch of small allocations spilled concurrently. thoughts on making spill decision "chiplet-aware"?
Matt: interesting. chiplet-aware as in prefer spilling from non-local banks first? that could reduce interconnect storms.
Kiran: yes, and for smallpage-heavy workloads we should avoid creating lots of tiny host allocations that thrash the page cache. maybe coalesce spill targets by slab class.
Luca: implementation sketch: annotate allocs with locality tag + slab_class. runtime spiller groups by (locality, slab_class) and issues batched transfers. reduces PCIe setup overhead.
Anya: example opt: 
```
alloc(size, opts={locality: "gpu0:bank2", slab_class: "small", spill_hint: "prefer_host"})
```
Matt: keep the API minimal. clients shouldn't have to name banks. offer an auto-locality derived by runtime most of the time.
Kiran: agree. make opt fields optional; let allocator derive fine-grained tags. but we need a compact on-wire representation for traces.
Anya: telemetry ask: include a spill_group_id so we can correlate a batch spill with subsequent latency spikes. cheap to emit in traces.
Luca: for batching transfers, we also need a soft token per-tenant to rate-limit concurrent DMA streams. otherwise a single tenant can monopolize NVLink lanes.
Matt: token vending idea: allocator returns a token handle on heavy allocs, token is consumed at spill time; tokens are refcounted so multi-chunk spills are accounted for.
Kiran: edge case: bulk restore of many small allocs after cold start. token acquisition has to be async-friendly to avoid blocking critical paths.
Anya: rollout plan:
1) no-op flags + metric framing
2) add locality tagging in allocator (no behavioral change)
3) implement grouped spiller in dev/runtime with tokens
4) 5% canary then expand
SRE-bot: perf-ci: chiplet-spill branch -> tests: 112/114 passed, 2 flaky GPU tests skipped :warning:
Luca: we also discussed frag accounting: try two-level sampling: slab-sample + periodic full-scan for tenants flagged by sampler. cheaper than per-page counters.
Kiran: add tenant thresholds to trigger scans. default: sample_rate=0.001, scan when estimated_frag > 20%.
Matt: backwards-compat: export an "est_frag_v1" metric that maps old per-page metric to the sampler estimate for dashboards. add compatibility shim in the exporter.
Anya: can we reuse existing metrics labels (tenant, pool, slab_class) so dashboards don't need schema changes?
Luca: yes. sampler emits same labels + sampler_version label.
Kiran: final ask: ensure KV cache path propagates spill grouping. cached entries shouldn't get extra tokens unless they actually move.
Anya: i'll draft the mini-RFC with sketches of token lifecycle and exporter shim. will open PR for the allocator tagging first.
Matt: i'll review the RFC. also want a small unit test harness for token races.
SRE-bot: note: please add perf test that simulates 10k small allocations + concurrent spill/restore.
Anya: noted. thanks everyone — filing GH issue and linking perf harness repro.
